correctness.rationale: Two deletion positions i<j give the same word iff the entire interval i…j is constant, impossible here. Disjoint shadows are exactly the decoding condition and must include descendants with adjacent repeats. The supplied color-prefix search is sound: independent color classes bound a clique on the remaining prefix, and each feasible extension has a largest processed vertex, so it is visited or excluded by the bound. Independently rebuilt the incidence and conflict masks from the definition, checked all supplied witnesses, and excluded a family of size M_n+1 by exact branching on a group of mutually conflicting words (one member or none); partitioning the remaining candidates into such groups gives a valid upper bound. This proved (1,1,3,4,8,12,22), with 1,837,807 nodes for the length-seven upper bound. For the ordinary packing LP, an independent rational replay checked every primal load and dual cover against the rebuilt incidence and verified equality of objectives (1,3/2,3,9/2,42/5,27/2,99/4). The empty word gives both optima at n=1. Lengths through six give fewer than 16 messages, while the length-seven witness suffices; its additive LP gap is 99/4−22=11/4. No assertion about later lengths or an asymptotic capacity is validated.
